run.command: strata bench run --url http://127.0.0.1:18500 --credential-env STRATA_BENCH_KEY --suite standard-v1 --track custom --track-notes desktop app setup (Strata terminal 0.2.4.1, engine 0.1.52 release binary, preset 'IQ3_XXS 256K'): context 262144, --kv int8 --kv-resident 32768, --expert-cache auto, --prefill auto, --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0.5, --mtp rt, layer split auto K=35 across both cards, vision on the CPU, conversation cache 8192 MiB / 2 slots --quantization IQ3_XXS --custom-pack native expert pack iq3_xxs (largest blob 2.33 MB) plus the PLE table read directly from the second GGUF shard; locally built expert profile data/expert-profile-iq3_xss.bin (24576 ranked pairs) --background Windows 11 desktop session: Edge, Notepad++, NVIDIA overlay, GameViewer and MiPcContinuity running; the Strata desktop app is connected to the same server; strata-vision runs on the CPU with 8 threads
